id: benign: the drafts key is removed once or twice when a session ends

test: ^signin\.spec\.ts > a session that ends on the server

id: benign: the unsaved-changes dialog is on screen for a frame after a save
why: the guard asks about a section the save has just made clean and closes the question itself; the dialog was seen on both builds, and where focus lands in it is a matter of timing
test: ^subject-access\.spec\.ts > a subject's groups and roles change

id: benign: the focus returned to a trigger as a test ends is recorded or not
why: the last focus event of these two tests (the dialog closing, the focus going back to its button) races the end of the test; the base lacks it in some runs and has it in others
test: ^(shell\.spec\.ts > on a phone > shows the top bar|subjects\.spec\.ts > a lockout is shown and cleared)
